newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Andes buys into shipping company.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes buys into shipping company.

text.p: Pacific Andes (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it had expanded its seafood supply operations by taking a majority stake in a company operating factory vessels.
The company's subsidiary, Lions City Investment Inc, had bought a 51 percent equity in Maritime Pacific Investment Group Ltd (MPIGL) for US$2.9 million in cash.
Navigator Investment Group Ltd holds the remaining 49 percent equity in MPIGL, whose main asset is two factory vessels operating in the north Pacific Ocean.
Each ship carries about 400 workers operating plants processing raw fish.
"Our strategy is to integrate sourcing operations. The acquisition of an equity interest in MPIGL is a further step in this direction," Pacific Andes managing director Frank Ng said in the statement.
